faqs.question: What data attributes do you provide?
faqs.answer: We can provide business email, key executive names and LinkedIn URLs, company name, industry, employee size, company domain, and job title — scoped to your targeting requirements.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of data-driven marketing?
faqs.answer: With verified B2B data you can reach the right decision-makers faster: higher lead generation, better targeting and personalization, improved sales efficiency, and stronger retention when you market to the right accounts.

faqs.question: For what industries do you provide data?
faqs.answer: We work across industries — healthcare, manufacturing, technology, education, and many more. Tell us your verticals and we build lists to match.

faqs.question: In what format do you provide the data?
faqs.answer: We deliver lists in Excel format for easy access and CRM import.

faqs.question: Do you verify the data before delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We focus on accurate, reliable contacts so you can reach the right leads with better deliverability.

faqs.question: Can you provide data from small businesses too?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support company-size bands from 1–50 through 5000+ employees, including SMB and enterprise.

faqs.question: How long does list delivery usually take?
faqs.answer: Most standard list orders complete within 1–2 business days. Custom multi-geo or enrichment jobs can take longer. If it passes 3 business days, follow up with your order ID.

faqs.question: Why is bounce higher than expected after export?
faqs.answer: Before blaming the file, check suppression lists, domain warm-up, and whether old CRM contacts were mixed into the same campaign. Bounce around ~8% often points to sending hygiene or list mixing rather than a single export issue.

faqs.question: How do I improve email list deliverability?
faqs.answer: Suppress unsubscribes and hard bounces, prefer recently verified segments, warm domains gradually, keep copy relevant to the persona, and monitor bounce/complaint rates after each batch. Share sample bounce codes with support if rates stay high.

faqs.question: How do teams stay GDPR-friendly with purchased B2B lists?
faqs.answer: This is not legal advice — talk to your counsel. Operationally, teams document lawful basis, honor opt-outs fast, prefer role-based B2B contacts, avoid scraping personal inboxes, and keep clear unsubscribe paths.

faqs.question: Password reset email never arrives — what should I do?
faqs.answer: Ask IT to allowlist our sender domain, confirm the email matches your original purchase, check spam, and retry. If it still fails, open a support ticket with company name and order ID. Use Forgot password on the sign-in page — we cannot reset passwords for you manually.

faqs.question: How do I reset my account password?
faqs.answer: Go to sign-in → Forgot password → enter the email on your account → open the reset link (check spam) → set a new password. If nothing arrives, confirm the purchase email and contact support with company name and order ID.

faqs.question: Do you have APAC coverage for marketing titles?
faqs.answer: Yes — including Singapore and Malaysia VP/Head of Marketing. Depth depends on company size, industry, and title mix. Share your ICP with your account executive for a count estimate before ordering.

faqs.question: Can I filter by CRM or marketing stack?
faqs.answer: Technographic filters (e.g. HubSpot or Salesforce) are available as add-ons on some packages. Ask your AE — not every firmographic-only build includes stack filters by default.

faqs.question: Best way to push contacts into Salesforce?
faqs.answer: Map Email as an external ID when possible, match Company to Account Name, store LinkedIn URL in a custom field, and deduplicate before import. Many teams stage in a sheet first, then VLOOKUP Accounts.

faqs.question: When should I use the email permutator vs verified lists?
faqs.answer: Use the permutator to enrich known names, then verify. It is not a substitute for a verified database pull.

faqs.question: What if my list count comes up short?
faqs.answer: For short counts on rare title combos, open a support ticket with your order ID. We review delivery against the scoped filters and typically offer credit or replenishment when the count falls short of what was confirmed.

faqs.question: Should I use the remove-duplicate tool or Excel?
faqs.answer: Run the on-site remove-duplicate tool on email first, then optionally a second pass on domain + title in Sheets for edge cases before CRM upload.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right B2B segment?
faqs.answer: Start from who can buy or influence your product, which titles reply in past campaigns, and which geos you can support. Avoid mixing too many industries, targeting only C-level when managers own the workflow, or ignoring company size vs your pricing.

faqs.question: How does pricing work?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on volume, filters (title, industry, geo), and any enrichment add-ons. Share your ICP in this chat or on the contact form and sales will send a tailored quote.

faqs.question: How do I buy a B2B email list?
faqs.answer: Tell us your target titles, industries, geos, and volume. We scope the count, confirm filters, and deliver a verified Excel list — usually within 1–2 business days for standard orders. Use this chat or Contact Us to start.

faqs.question: Can I book a demo?
faqs.answer: Yes. Leave your details in this chat (or Contact Us) and mention you’d like a demo — sales will schedule a walkthrough of coverage, samples, and workflow.

faqs.question: Can I get a sample before buying?
faqs.answer: Yes — ask sales for a sample aligned to your ICP. Share industry, titles, and geo so the sample reflects what you’d order.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Use Contact Us on the site, email sales@thedatabaseproviders.com, or leave details in this chat. For open orders, include your order ID and company name.

faqs.question: Do you cover multiple countries?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build global and regional lists (including US, India, UAE, Singapore, Malaysia, and more). Multi-geo custom jobs can take longer than standard single-geo deliveries.
